newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot gas eases on plant restarts, weather.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot gas eases on plant restarts, weather.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices drifted lower Thursday amid little weather-related demand and the return to service of some Alberta gas plants, traders said.

Spot gas at the AECO storage hub in Alberta was quoted at C$1.52-1.55 per gigajoule, down about two cents from Wednesday. July AECO was also discussed lower at C$1.46-1.48 per GJ, while July/October eased to about C$1.47-1.50.
"Field receipts are coming back on, and line pack is rising. Storage injections will probably rise this weekend," one Calgary-based trader said.
